50:1.text: [These letters (Qâf, etc.) are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân, and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings]

50:2.text: Nay, they wonder that there has come to them a warner
from among themselves. So the disbelievers say: "This is a strange thing!

50:3.text: "When we are dead and have become dust

50:4.text: We know that which the earth takes of them
, and with Us is a Book preserved

50:5.text: Nay, but they have denied the truth
when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state

50:6.text: Have they not looked at the heaven above them, how We have made it and adorned it, and there are no rifts in it?

50:7.text: And the earth! We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and have produced therein every kind of lovely growth

50:8.text: An insight and a Reminder for every slave who turns to Allâh in repentance
(i.e. the one who believes in the Oneness of Allâh and performs deeds of His obedience, and always begs His pardon)

50:9.text: And We send down blessed water
from the sky, then We produce therewith gardens and grain

50:10.text: And tall date-palms, with ranged clusters.

50:11.text: slaves. And We give life therewith to a dead land. Thus will be the resurrection

50:12.text: , and the dwellers of Rass, and Thamûd;

50:14.text: And the Dwellers of the Wood, and the people of Tubba‘. Everyone of them denied
Messengers, so My Threat took effect.

50:15.text: Were We then tired with the first creation? Nay, they are in confused doubt about a new creation
